name: Route 43 and Mahogany Town
summary: Arrive in Mahogany Town, a quiet northern mountain enclave. Buy a local RageCandyBar from the eastern gate vendor for $300, and visit the elderly seamstress north of the gym to purchase warm winter apparel: Indigo Ice Beams, Snow Coat (Female), and Snow Coat (Male). Then journey north onto Route 43 along the highway leading to the Lake of Rage. Navigate through tall grass roamed by wild Girafarig, Venomoth, and Flaaffy, challenge Pokemaniac Shane, and collect a Max Elixir and Wise Glasses from the western river islets.

items.name: RageCandyBar
items.method: Purchased from the salesman blocking the eastern gatehouse for $300

items.name: Wise Glasses
items.method: Found on a secluded river islet on the northwest side of Route 43

items.name: Max Elixir
items.method: Located on a small grassy islet on the west side of Route 43
